title: Reinstating a Suspended Paystride Payroll Card Program — Desk Tool Reference
content:
## Rule

The desk reinstates a suspended Paystride Payroll Card Program once its funding balance has been restored, moving it back to live and debiting its reinstatement fee in the same step as a fee of the reinstatement kind pointing to the cure payment; a reinstatement fee that comes to zero is not debited, and a package whose reinstatement fee is zero is reinstated without a fee.

A reinstatement is charged once, when the desk reinstates the program, pointing to the cure payment, at the reinstatement fee figured for it rather than at the package's flat reinstatement fee; an early termination is charged at the early termination fee its own charge sets; a late batch, a returned funding payment, a corrected load file and a load reversal request are each charged once, pointing to the entry or request that incurred them, as the base rule provides.

**The cure payment.** The cure payment is the most recent funding receipt when it is dated on or after the entry date of the most recent funding return, and there is no cure payment when the most recent funding receipt is older than that return or the program has no funding return.

## The reinstatement tool

Reinstatement is booked with `reinstate_suspended_program_c7549ab9`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Capability.** It reinstates an employer's suspended Payroll Card Program and debits its reinstatement fee in the same step. The program's status becomes live, so payroll batches funded by any allowed method post again; when the fee is above zero, one fee entry of the reinstatement kind is added to the funding account history, dated today and pointing to the funding receipt that cured the account, and the funding balance falls by the fee. A fee of zero reinstates the program without a fee entry. The employer sees the program live again and, where charged, the fee in the funding history.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `paycard_program_id` | the reference number of the employer's Payroll Card Program to reinstate, as returned by the program lookup for this employer | identifier |
| `related_entry_id` | the reference number of the funding receipt that cured the account, as shown in the program's funding account history | identifier |
| `reinstatement_fee_usd` | the reinstatement fee in US dollars | zero or a positive number with 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half up to the cent before it is booked |

### Return

A line beginning "Program reinstated" indicates the reinstatement was booked. It gives the program reference, its new status (live), the fee entry reference (a text identifier, or none when no fee was debited), the fee debited (US dollars, two decimal places) and the funding balance afterwards (US dollars, two decimal places).

### Cure payment cases (hypothetical)

| Most recent funding return | Most recent funding receipt | Cure payment |
|---|---|---|
| entry dated 3 April | dated 6 April | the 6 April receipt |
| entry dated 3 April | dated 3 April | the 3 April receipt |
| entry dated 3 April | dated 1 April | none |
| no funding return on the program | any | none |
